messages:
Zoe Lee: hey folks! Im Zoe (she/her) — starting on ML Infra / Inference today. Remote CET. quick questions: who do I ping if the MDM invite never shows? need access to the staging GPU pool for some small perf tests and a service account to run a nightly eval job. whos my buddy? fun fact: I brew kombucha and collect vintage teapots. :tea:

Marta (People Ops): welcome Zoe!! :tada: sticker pack & welcome kit on the way. New-hire orientation invite sent. For laptops, default is MacBook Pro 14" — reply if you want Linux instead. Ill confirm buddy assignment shortly.

Evan (IT): hi Zoe  MDM invites usually go out automatically. If you dont see it: visit https://intranet.redwood/mdm-enroll and re-open Company Portal. For GPU/staging access, open the access portal and request role `staging-gpu` and `eval-service-account`. Example request body: `purpose: nightly evals for retrieval model, ttl: 7d`. Paste your SSH pubkey in your profile so scripts can provision. Quick command: `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy`

Priya N. (Buddy): hey Zoe  Im Priya, your buddy for the first month. :coffee: Ill DM to set a 30-min intro sync and walk through the small onboarding tasks (CLA, runbook readme, quick smoke test). I can also help get the GPU pool request bumped if you need earlier access.

Zoe Lee: thanks all — I see the MDM invite now, Evan. submitted the access requests (ticket #HD-2032).

DevexBot: Reminder: join #eng-runtime and #devex for docs, pairing slots, and the repo checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/ONBOARDING.md

Evan (IT): noted ticket HD-2032, will approve `staging-gpu` after manager sign-off. Service account provisioning requires a short justification and TTL.

Marta (People Ops): buddy confirmed: Priya will be your buddy. Welcome lunch on Friday 12pm PT if youre in-office — bring kombucha if you want :smile:

Zoe Lee: awesome, thanks everyone! Priya Ill accept the invite. posting a quick hello in #eng-runtime now. :rocket:
